name: Structural Editing
description: Performs structural (developmental) editing on documents, producing an editorial memo with assessment and a restructured outline showing proposed reorganization, reordering, and section changes. Use when the user asks for structural editing, developmental editing, document reorganization, or help with the overall structure and flow of a piece. Do NOT use for line-level editing (use copy-editing), proofreading (use proofreading), or tone changes (use tone-adjustment).
